optimizer_gist: Performance improved dramatically by locking `min_perf_pct` at 100, setting `cstate_max` to POLL, and reducing scheduler latencies to the 4–5ms range. Future runs should fix these high-impact parameters and focus narrow-range sweeps on `migration_cost_ns` (150k–200k) and `napi_busy_poll` (200–225) where the most stable results were observed. Fixing the scheduler granularities to approximately 10% of the `latency_ns` also appears to be a reliable heuristic for this workload.
